name: grafana
description: Amazon Managed Grafana is a fully managed and secure data visualization service that you can use to instantly query, correlate, and visualize operational metrics, logs, and traces from multiple sources.

subcommands.name: associate-license
subcommands.description: Assigns a Grafana Enterprise license to a workspace.

subcommands.name: create-workspace
subcommands.description: Creates a workspace.

subcommands.name: create-workspace-api-key
subcommands.description: Creates a Grafana API key for the workspace.

subcommands.name: create-workspace-service-account
subcommands.description: Creates a service account for the workspace.

subcommands.name: create-workspace-service-account-token
subcommands.description: Creates a token that can be used to authenticate and authorize Grafana HTTP API operations for the given workspace service account.

subcommands.name: delete-workspace
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace.

subcommands.name: delete-workspace-api-key
subcommands.description: Deletes a Grafana API key for the workspace.

subcommands.name: delete-workspace-service-account
subcommands.description: Deletes a workspace service account from the workspace.

subcommands.name: delete-workspace-service-account-token
subcommands.description: Deletes a token for the workspace service account.

subcommands.name: describe-workspace
subcommands.description: Displays information about one Amazon Managed Grafana workspace.

subcommands.name: describe-workspace-authentication
subcommands.description: Displays information about the authentication methods used in one Amazon Managed Grafana workspace.

subcommands.name: describe-workspace-configuration
subcommands.description: Gets the current configuration string for the given workspace.

subcommands.name: disassociate-license
subcommands.description: Removes the Grafana Enterprise license from a workspace.

subcommands.name: list-permissions
subcommands.description: Lists the users and groups who have the Grafana Admin and Editor roles in this workspace.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: The ListTagsForResource operation returns the tags that are associated with the Amazon Managed Service for Grafana resource specified by the resourceArn.

subcommands.name: list-versions
subcommands.description: Lists available versions of Grafana.

subcommands.name: list-workspace-service-account-tokens
subcommands.description: Returns a list of tokens for a workspace service account.

subcommands.name: list-workspace-service-accounts
subcommands.description: Returns a list of service accounts for a workspace.

subcommands.name: list-workspaces
subcommands.description: Returns a list of Amazon Managed Grafana workspaces in the account, with some information about each workspace.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: The TagResource operation associates tags with an Amazon Managed Grafana resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: The UntagResource operation removes the association of the tag with the Amazon Managed Grafana resource.

subcommands.name: update-permissions
subcommands.description: Updates which users in a workspace have the Grafana Admin or Editor roles.

subcommands.name: update-workspace
subcommands.description: Modifies an existing Amazon Managed Grafana workspace.

subcommands.name: update-workspace-authentication
subcommands.description: Use this operation to define the identity provider (IdP) that this workspace authenticates users from, using SAML.

subcommands.name: update-workspace-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration string for the given workspace
